source.snapshot: Source-only public snapshot with fresh Git history

intent: Portable, deterministic project-local governance preserving explicit project authority and independently verified scope success.

criteria.contracts: Seven focused checks: project binding, scope/intent/criteria and result semantics; capacity validation does not activate workers.
criteria.actions: Nine actual-Git/recorded-adapter tests: plan/apply, instruction freshness including quality policy, authority, exact readback, uncertain writes and idempotency.
criteria.review: One real committed synthetic behavior change: full source-bound policy, 39 review conditions, missing intent proof refused, check fails before fix and passes afterwards, compact bundle retains full selected leaves and unknown usage.
criteria.cli: Six actual command/baseline/scope/loop checks, including automatic checkout-bound scope-v2 creation from committed Markdown and readable validation without hash output, missing policy, foreign/stale source and typed loop routes.
criteria.specification: Three focused tests parse strict request/design Markdown, validate the approved dev-stack pair, require separate acceptance, matching revisions, Mermaid diagrams, stable decisions and committed unchanged files; legacy paths and scope v1 are refused.
criteria.loop: Six focused state-machine checks cover initial build, defect repair, complete verification, distinct scope/oracle/environment/blocked routing, retry/time budgets, terminal records and source mismatch. A two-iteration local pilot failed on subtraction, routed to build, passed after addition and routed to report.
criteria.installer: Six lifecycle groups on empty/existing projects: readable pending plans without human digests, install/verify/no-op, changed release/adapter refusal, archive permission normalisation with byte and executable-bit integrity, identical existing-file adoption and restoration after upgrade, rollback/remove, conflicts, duplicate skills and interrupted recovery.
criteria.worker: Forty-eight worker, admission and runtime checks cover explicit provider/model configuration, disabled package defaults, patch/native-child behavior, four-attempt correction bounds across activation changes, canonical-runner consistency, public wrappers and the bubblewrap boundary. No paid worker call was run.
criteria.skills: All 51 canonical/native skill files passed structural validation, including five portable reconciliation skills and their native routers. Selection remains conditional; validation alone does not prove host discovery.
criteria.package: Explicit 168-file portable path inventory, release-level branding regression check, project MIT licence and retained third-party notices; no application source or private history. Thirty-seven Node governance tests passed.

leadAssessment: The source release passed governance and installer checks before this public snapshot. Local artifacts meet recorded portable-core, skill and installation intent. Commands and valid records do not prove application acceptance or a live external-model run.
remaining: First project adoption requires its own scope and acceptance
Live provider configuration and application outcomes remain unproven
noClaims: No new provider setup or worker activation
